title: Causal MaleCNS engineering showcase, assembled from independent behaviour contracts
status: PREREGISTERED AND BLOCKED. The public cut may be built only after every gate below passes.
why_v1_is_not_the_final_demo: Its navigation includes a raw world-gradient steering term and central olfactory relays, so it is not the causal DEMO-01 visual route.
Its exact hero records 8.477 mm of net displacement during grooming against its own 2.5 mm cap.
Its contamination and grooming ablations stop the serial state machine before any later behaviour, so they are sequence-dependency checks rather than independent behaviour controls.
It has one food position, no command-replay or controller-only comparison, and its cinematic is 13.6 seconds rather than the required explanatory comparison cut.
presentation_model: Three separately executed causal chapters. Editing may connect them into one story, but the video must never imply that one run generated all three behaviours.

navigation.route: visual cue -> retinotopic lamina surrogate -> full graph -> descending readout -> decoder -> body
forbidden: raw world-coordinate or cue-bearing input to the decoder

grooming.note: A causal trigger is insufficient: the body must remain within the registered one-body-length cap.

feeding.blocking_precondition: demo02-feeding-operating-point-v1 selects a point using neural-only criteria before any embodied feeding result is opened
feeding.required_verdict_prefix: FULL-GRAPH CAUSAL PROBOSCIS EXTENSION FROM TARSAL TASTE

required_labels: V0 Structural; no new validation tier

claim_if_every_gate_passes: Three separately controlled full-graph engineering demonstrations: visual-target approach, antennal-grooming initiation with bounded body drift, and tarsal-taste-triggered feeding initiation.
claim_boundary: Engineering presentation only. It awards no tier, validates no physiological mechanism, and is not one autonomous multi-behaviour run.
